blocks.text: Ready for a Halloween celebration packed with chills, thrills, and plenty of fun? This October, Robinsons Malls invites families, friends, kids, and their furry companions to embrace the spooky season with creative activities, exciting adventures, sweet treats, and fright-filled movie nights. Whether you’re looking for a fun afternoon with the kids, a good scare with your friends on the big screen, or simply need an excuse to dress up with your fur-babies, there’s something waiting for everyone. Step into the Halloween Spirit! No Halloween celebration is complete without costumes and candy. Kids can come dressed as their favorite spooky characters and […]...
